conventions.packing: row-major values, b bits each, little-endian bit stream (bit j -> bit j%8 of byte j//8), byte padding at the end of each matrix; codes [out,in] at b bits, zero-points [out,groups] at b bits, scales FP16 [out,groups]; masks [out,in] at 1 bit (1 = kept)
conventions.pruning: per output row; row zeros k=Z//out, rows with index < Z%out get k+1; lowest scores pruned, ties pruned in increasing column order (stable sort); 2:4 keeps the 2 highest of each 4 contiguous input columns; scores FP32: magnitude |W|, Wanda |W|*||X_j||_2 with ||X_j|| over all calibration tokens of the input
conventions.quantizer: asymmetric uniform, group 128 contiguous input columns per row; s=(max-min)/(2^b-1) in FP32 cast to FP16; FP16 s==0 -> s=1; z=clamp(round(-min/s),0,2^b-1); q=clamp(round(w/s)+z,0,2^b-1); w_hat=s*(q-z) in FP32 then model dtype; round half to even; no clipping search; no padding (width multiple of 128)
conventions.storage: fp16: 2 B/weight; sparse16: ceil(n/8) mask bytes + 2 B per nonzero per matrix; packed: ceil(n*b/8) code bytes + 2 B FP16 scale per group + ceil(G*b/8) zero-point bytes per matrix, group size 128 along input columns; whole model adds non-eligible parameters at FP16, tied once
